summary: Backend-only validation of new financial-app-style dashboard fields, PATCH /api/auth/me (profile+logo), and PUT /api/representadas/{id} logo persistence. Created /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_profile.py with 13 tests covering: dashboard new fields presence/types (mes_atual, despesas_mes, saldo_mes, em_atraso, em_atraso_count, projecao_valor, projecao_comissao, gastos_por_categoria sorted desc, saude_financeira 0-100, saude_label in {Excelente,Boa,Regular,Ruim}, avisos<=5 with titulo/valor/tipo), legacy field regression (faturamento_mes, serie_faturamento, top_produtos), PATCH /auth/me updates+persists name/logo/empresa/telefone without leaking password_hash, PUT /representadas/{id} persists logo (visible via GET), plus regression on login/me/logout, cron backup 401/200, and /api/backups admin access. 13/13 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 977 lines — still recommended to split into routers (auth, crm, dashboard, backup, xml) for maintainability.
PATCH /api/auth/me accepts arbitrary logo payload without size validation; large base64 blobs could bloat the users doc. Consider a max length (e.g., 500KB) and MIME whitelist.
Same observation applies to PUT /api/representadas logo field — no size/format validation.
/api/backups is still protected only by get_current_user (not admin-only) per prior review — snapshots can contain sensitive data; recommend role='admin' guard.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True remains misconfigured for credentialed cookie flows.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded admin + demo representadas. PATCH /auth/me mutated admin profile (name='Alvaro Admin TEST', empresa='OmniRep TEST', telefone, logo). Representada[0] updated with logo. These are non-destructive persisted mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard new fields, profile PATCH with logo, and representada logo PUT are fully validated. Note that this test suite leaves admin.name='Alvaro Admin TEST' and representada[0].logo persisted — if UI testing follows, main agent may want to reset the admin name via a subsequent PATCH. test_dashboard_profile.py and test_backup_cron.py are both reusable for regression.
